# linux_sed (Resource)

Edits an existing file in place with `sed` expressions. When running the expressions would change the file again, Terraform plans to apply them again: write idempotent expressions, such as `s/^#?Port .*/Port 2222/`, rather than `s/a/aa/`. Destroying the resource leaves the file as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "linux_sed" "sshd" {
  path     = "/etc/ssh/sshd_config"
  extended = true

  # Idempotent expressions: running them again leaves the file unchanged.
  expressions = [
    "s/^#?PermitRootLogin .*/PermitRootLogin no/",
    "s/^#?PasswordAuthentication .*/PasswordAuthentication no/",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expressions` (List of String) `sed` expressions, each passed with `-e`, such as `s/^#?PermitRootLogin .*/PermitRootLogin no/`.
- `path` (String) Absolute path of the file to edit.

### Optional

- `extended` (Boolean) Use extended regular expressions (`sed -E`). Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Path of the file.
